instances.why: Line 11 quantifies universally over a collection of 'Cent' objects, but everything before it names only a coin denomination, a single object, and the 500 billion circulating Lincoln cents — a kind of thing, not the artwork's population. The bounded set with fixed membership ('a permanent set of ten thousand') arrives only at line 18, seven lines after the claim that depends on it, and lines 12–16 all hang off that same unestablished set, which is also why line 18's 'ten thousand' has no head noun to count.
